messages:
Alex: Heads-up — saw GPU saturation in eu-west yesterday during the midday spike, and a bunch of org keys hit 429s even though cluster had some idle nodes in other regions. Thinking we need a tiny shim that adapts token-bucket refill by region headroom + per-org weight. Observations: proxy queues grew, autoscaler was slow because pods got Pending. Thoughts?

Priya: Oof. Any graphs/metrics? which models were hot?

Alex: Short list: small-chat-cpu (cheap) + reranker-heavy models. Node-level GPU util hit ~98% in eu-west-2 for ~12m. Two nodes in eu-central had ~20% util. Traffic couldn't fail over because our routing is region-pinned for latency-sensitive keys. Admission control didn't consider region headroom.

Mateo: We should avoid blind cross-region failover for low-latency tiers. Alternative: reduce per-key burst allowance in congested region and offer a "deferred" overflow path to other regions for customers who opt-in.

Jen: Proto formula idea: adaptive_refill = base_refill * (available_slots / total_slots) per-region. If region at 90% util, refill drops to ~10% of base. Keep a small guaranteed per-org floor.

Sam: How do we get available_slots? Scheduler can expose a headroom API that returns integer available concurrent inference slots per region. ops-bot: headroom API endpoint is https://infra.internal/headroom (eventually-consistent, 5s scrape).

Alex: Sketch config for proxy shim:

```
admission {
  bucket_type: "token"
  base_qps: 5
  burst_tokens: 50
  dynamic_refill: true
  refill_formula: "r = base_qps * max(0, headroom/total_slots)"
  guaranteed_floor: 1
}
```

Priya: We must smooth refill changes to avoid oscillation. Add EWMA smoothing + min-change-interval (30s).

Mateo: Also track per-org debt: when we throttle an org we record deficit and allow slow draining later. This avoids punishing bursty but steady customers long-term.

Jen: Cross-region overflow has cost implications: egress and reserved capacity. Only enable for enterprise customers or those who opt-in. Add a billing flag/limit.

Alex: Also propose a soft-queue: instead of immediate 429, return 202 + Retry-After when queue length < threshold, and 429 when queue full. That gives clients a chance to wait.

Sam: For SDK/clients, add headers: `X-Preferred-Region` and `X-Overflow-OK:true` so we know who opted into overflow.

Priya: PoC plan: implement adaptive refill in the proxy sidecar. Poll headroom API every 10s, EWMA alpha=0.2, min-change-interval=30s. Emit metrics: regional_refill_ratio, per_org_burst_consumed, per_org_deficit.

Mateo: I'll mock headroom API and run canary on staging tomorrow.

Jen: Add safety: if headroom API fails, fallback to conservative static refill (e.g., 20% of base). Also enforce max burst_tokens cap.

Alex: Action items:
- Mateo: PoC proxy-shim (staging) — due Tue
- Priya: Define EWMA params + guardrails + test plan — due Wed
- Jen: Cost policy for cross-region overflow — due Fri
- Sam: SDK header + opt-in flag docs — due Thu

Priya: Also add structured logs that correlate 429s to headroom state for postmortems (sampled).

Alex: If the adaptive refill can't bring down pressure we should add queue prioritization by org tier (gold > silver > free).

Sam: I'll put a feature-flag gate so we can roll out per-customer.

Jen: :thumbsup:

ops-bot: deploy/canary started for proxy-shim branch by Mateo — status: queued

Alex: Thanks all — sync tomorrow 10:30 to review PoC results.
